name: 极睿视频分析
examples_zh: 分析这个商品视频的脚本、风格、卖点和爆款公式
帮我拆解这个品牌视频的视觉风格和叙事结构
从这个视频提取可复用的生成提示词
examples_en: Analyze this product video's script, style, selling points, and viral formula
Break down this brand video's visual style and narrative structure
Extract a reusable generation prompt from this video
description_zh: 对用户主动提供的视频执行结构化拆解，安全调用分析任务并交付脚本、风格、卖点、爆款结构和可复用的视频生成提示词。
description_en: Run a structured breakdown of a user-supplied video: safely call the analysis task and deliver the script, visual style, selling points, viral structure, and a reusable video generation prompt, with explicit separate billing authorization before any billable call.
